note: Internal log of AI policy changes first seen by the AIShorts Policy Desk. Newest first.

entries.title: Special Act on Promotion of Artificial Intelligence Data Centres (Bill no. 2215928) including tax or social insurance relief was introduced to the National Assembly
Personal Information Protection Commission opened consultation on amendment to Enforcement Decree of Personal Information Protection Act
Global Online Safety Regulators Network adopted Position Statement on AI-generated Child Sexual Abuse Material and Non-Consensual Intimate Imagery
Digital Regulation Cooperation Forum members set out expectations for firms launching personal AI agents in joint letter to government ministers
Global Privacy Assembly adopted Resolution on Privacy-protective Agentic AI
Global Privacy Assembly adopted Resolution on Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Education
Survivor Justice Tax Prevention Act (HB 2347) rewritten as Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 including ratepayer protection for data centres was passed by the Senate
Advancing Uniform Disclosure of Investments and Transparency of Artificial Intelligence Act (SB 5785) was introduced to the Senate
European Union and United Kingdom announced intention to launch EU-UK Digital Partnership in Joint Statement of second EU-UK Summit
Data Protection Authority released report on safety of AI camera glasses
Stealth Bot Prohibition Act (SB 5766) was introduced to the Senate
Bureau of Industry and Security's interim final rule Addressing Remote Access to Advanced Semiconductors entered into force
Bureau of Industry and Security released interim final rule Addressing Remote Access to Advanced Semiconductors

Texas Attorney General filed lawsuit against OpenAI and its chief executive officer over alleged deceptive practices and violations of the Securing Children Online through Parental Empowerment Act regarding ChatGPT
Competition Commission concluded voluntary undertaking with X.AI replacing Media and Digital Platforms Market Inquiry remedies
California Attorney General filed lawsuit against OpenAI over alleged unsafe testing of artificial intelligence models and misleading safety claims

Budapest-Capital Regional Court submitted request for preliminary ruling to Court of Justice of the European Union on use of press publications in AI model training and text and data mining (Mobilguru v Google Ireland/C-829/26)
Ministry of Justice released interpretive guidelines on infringement of publicity rights by generative AI
Tokyo District Court dismissed Kenjiro Tsuda's claim against TikTok while finding that a person's voice can be protected under publicity rights
Superior Electoral Court fined Facebook BRL 7.5 million for non-compliance with orders on equal treatment of presidential campaigns (Brasil Pronto pra Mais Coalition v Meta)
Ending Forced Arbitration of Children Online Act of 2026 (SB 5720) was introduced to the Senate
Data Protection Authority reprimanded AI chatbot application provider and ordered General Data Protection Regulation compliance for processing of special categories of data in AI model training
House passed bill prohibiting certain uses of deepfakes and creating a private claim of action (HB 1432)
Decree for the establishment of the Spanish Agency for the Supervision of Artificial Intelligence entered into force
CEN-CENELEC standard on bias in AI systems and AI aided decision making (CEN/CLC ISO/IEC/TR 24027:2023) entered into force

Virginia Attorney General filed lawsuit against SpaceX Super Intelligence, X Corp. and Space Exploration Technologies over alleged misleading safety claims concerning sexualised images generated by Grok
House of Commons Business, Innovation, Science and Trade Committee published report on AI safety recommending AI Safety and Security Bill and new AI regulator
Department of Commerce designated 33 pre-set consortia export packages under the American AI Exports Program
Department for Business and Trade published guidance on application of EU AI Act to AI systems closely integrated into physical products in Northern Ireland
Ministry of Education approved National Education Council guidelines on use of artificial intelligence in education
